search.facilityHint: Hagaragara gusa ibigo wemerewe. Guhitamo ikindi bihindura ikigo ukoreramo.

search.emptyDescription: Reba uko wanditse, shakisha ukoresheje nomero y'igerageza, cyangwa usibe ibyungururo.
search.lastUpdated: Byavuguruwe bwa nyuma saa {{time}} — hagaragara ibyabitswe mbere y'ikibazo cy'umuyoboro.

duplicate.body: Dosiye ishobora kuba isubiyemo — banza wemeze umwirondoro mbere yo gufata icyemezo. Dosiye ntizigera zihuzwa mu buryo bwikora.
duplicate.candidates: Dosiye zishobora guhura nayo mu kigo cyawe

externalId.title: Kugenzura indangamuntu
externalId.description: Iyi porogaramu y'igerageza ntihujwe na serivisi y'indangamuntu y'igihugu. Umwirondoro hano ni nomero y'igerageza y'ikigo gusa.
externalId.unavailable: Serivisi y'indangamuntu y'igihugu ntihujwe muri iri gerageza. Nta mwirondoro wazanywe cyangwa wakozwe.

denied.body: Uyu murwayi w'igerageza ari hanze y'ikigo ukoreramo cyangwa y'uruhare rwawe rw'igerageza. Nta makuru y'umurwayi agaragazwa. Iki gikorwa cyanditswe mu gitabo cy'igenzura.

notFound.title: Nta murwayi w'igerageza ufite iyi nomero mu bigo byawe
notFound.description: Reba umuyoboro, cyangwa ushakishe umurwayi ukoresheje nomero y'igerageza cyangwa izina.
